ANNEXURE-D, IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE AND EQUITY.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
S G PANDIT, J., MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 -3-  NC: 2024:KHC-D:3474-DB  CCC No. 100205 of 2022  ORDER Heard learned counsel Sri Lingraj Maradi for complainant, learned HCGP for accused Nos.1, 2 and 5 and learned counsel Sri K.S.Patil accused Nos.3 and 4.
2.

This contempt petition is filed under Sections 11 and 12 of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971 read with Article 215 of the Constitution of India complaining disobedience of order dated 13.09.2021 in W.P.No.101255/2021, wherein this Court passed the following order.

"5. In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances and rival submissions,
respondent Nos.1 to 4 are hereby directed to address the grievances of the petitioner and consider their representation dated 19.10.2020 at Annexure-F and pass appropriate order in accordance with law, within a period of six months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order."
3. Order dated 16.08.2023 of this Court in the above contempt proceedings would indicate that accused Nos.3 and 4 have deposited a sum of Rs.50,00,000/- before this Court.

Sri Lingraj Maradi and Sri K.S.Patil would submit that subsequently notification u/sec.11 of the Right to NC: 2024:KHC-D:3474-DB Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short, 'the Act') is issued for acquisition of land.

entities.text: Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel for complainant and learned counsel for accused Nos.3 and 4 would submit that in view of the fact that Section 11 notification under the Act is issued, contempt petition would no more survive for consideration.
Accordingly, placing submission of the learned counsels on record, further proceedings are dropped.

Sd/-
JUDGE Sd/-
